Bellingham Walk.road: Narrow footpath/back-lane access with garage blocks; no markings visible.
Bellingham Walk.note: 1960s-70s two-storey terraces in buff/orange brick with brown tile-hung or boarded upper fronts, seen from behind over fences and garage courts; very leafy edges.

Greenleas Avenue.road: Two-lane residential road, no centre line, grass verges, wide pavements.
Greenleas Avenue.note: Mostly detached bungalows and chalet bungalows, red brick or white/cream render, behind low red-brick or stone walls with hedges and garden shrubs.

Yarnton Close.note: 1970s estate detached houses in orange-red brick, some with tile-hung or boarded panels, open-plan lawns, mature trees round the edge.

Jeferson Close.road: Private-feel cul-de-sac, block/tarmac, no markings, no pavement in parts.
Jeferson Close.note: 1990s executive detached houses in red brick with chimneys, double garages and gravel drives, open lawns; dense trees and hedges at the entrance.

Soane End.note: Only one viewpoint loaded; red brick detached houses and a dark-roofed bungalow mostly hidden behind tall hedges and fences.

Spinney Close.road: Quiet residential road, no centre line.
Spinney Close.note: Red-brick two-storey houses with tile roofs, partly hidden by front-garden trees, low stone/brick walls and hedges.

Venetia Close.road: Cul-de-sac with pavements, no markings, block-paved drives.
Venetia Close.note: 1960s-70s semis and detached houses in orange-red brick with white window bands, open front lawns, woodland backdrop.

Putting Green.note: Both viewpoints have no Street View panorama (black screen after retry).

one way.note: Both views have no Street View panorama (black screen after retry); the point is on a path near Highdown School.

Wetherby Close.note: 1960s-70s estate: brick semis with dark tile-hung/boarded upper bands and low buff bungalows, set back behind open lawns and young trees.

St Benets Way.road: Narrow curving estate road, no markings, block-paved edges.
St Benets Way.note: 2000s new-build houses in red brick with some cream render, grey slate-look roofs, chimneys and bay windows, shrubby front strips; heavy greenery.

Fishers Cottages.road: Narrow cul-de-sac with parking court, no markings.
Fishers Cottages.note: 1980s-90s small red-brick houses and starter flats with dark boarded gable panels, brown concrete tile roofs, parking courts and lawn strips.

Albany Gardens.road: Views are at the junction with Highdown Hill Road/Evans Ave: wide road, centre dashes and give-way lines at the junction, broad grass verges.
Albany Gardens.note: Only the junction is visible: interwar white-rendered and red-brick semis behind low brick walls and wide grass verges with big trees.

Gorselands.road: Curving cul-de-sac, no markings, grass verges.
Gorselands.note: 1980s detached houses with dormers and bungalows, all red brick with brown concrete tile roofs, integral garages and open lawns; mature trees around.

Cherry Close.road: Cul-de-sac, no markings, overhead phone wires.
Cherry Close.note: 1960s-70s detached bungalows in red or buff brick plus a few two-storey houses with boarded upper bands; open-plan lawns and drives with garages.

Gayhurst Close.note: 1970s estate semis and short terraces in orange brick with a white boarded or rendered band at first floor, shallow brown tile roofs, open drives.

Penn Close.note: Houses largely hidden by tall hedges; visible ones are buff and red brick postwar semis with chimneys.

Bluebell Gardens.road: New estate road, no markings, block-paved drives.
Bluebell Gardens.note: 2000s new-build red-brick semis and short terraces with gables, dark tile roofs and small open lawns with low post-and-rail edging.

Mallory Avenue.road: Estate road, no markings, block-paved drives to the kerb.
Mallory Avenue.note: 1960s-70s brick semis and short terraces, some with white/cream boarded or rendered first floors, block-paved drives and low brick or fence boundaries.

Eagle Way.note: Both viewpoints have no Street View panorama (black screen after retry).

Caversham Park Drive.road: Junction with Peppard Road: wide road, white edge lines, big trees and railings.
Caversham Park Drive.note: Only the Peppard Road end (black railings, big trees, hedges) and a photosphere of the Caversham Park mansion (pale stone, columned) loaded; no houses on the drive itself were seen.

Autumn Close.note: 1960s-70s houses in buff or red brick with dark-stained weatherboarded first floors, shallow brown tile roofs and open lawns.

Fox Crescent.road: Views are from Kidmore End Road at the entrance: wide road, grass verge, narrow access lane into the crescent.
Fox Crescent.note: Seen only from the entrance: 1990s red-brick detached houses with gables behind thick hedges and big trees.

Aldenham Close.note: 1970s link-detached houses in buff/orange brick with white boarded first-floor panels, integral garages and block-paved open frontages.

Michael King Way.note: No Street View panorama at the viewpoint (black screen after retry).

Lyefield Court.road: Narrow private-style court, block paving, no markings.
Lyefield Court.note: 1990s red-brick gabled houses behind a brick boundary wall and timber fences, with large trees.
